question: In a certain code language, ‘INDIA’ is written as ‘103’ and ‘ARAB’ is written as ‘90’. How will ‘AFRICA’ be written in that language?
solution:
The positions of the letters according to the English alphabet series:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/889ff2be8a048327f450a975a401b2f4241e5f28d86896613386ad4014cb4505.png] 

**__LOGIC__: Positional Values of Reverse Positional Letters + Number of letters in the given word = Code.**

The pattern for this is as follows;

**In INDIA →**

I ⇔ R = 18

N ⇔ M = 13
